grade.summary: The submission gives a complete equivalent proof that all solutions are exactly f(x)=x+c with c≥0. It correctly derives orbit invariance and nonnegativity of g=f-id, proves equality of all positive defect values using nearby forward-orbit points, excludes coexistence of zero and positive defects via the stated neighborhood-propagation argument, and verifies the converse.
strengths: Correctly obtains g(f(y))=g(y) and f^(n)(y)=y+ng(y), hence g(y)≥0.
Derives the decisive range estimate |g(x)-g(z)|≤(√x-√z)^2 and uses it correctly to equate positive defect values.
Correctly rules out mixed defect levels; the iteration of the explicit neighborhoods is routine and sufficient.
Checks both inequalities for f(x)=x+c by exact square identities.
